test.name: Historical person lookup
test.description: Wikipedia lookup for a person, run with NO project (scenario null, no projectPath). research_log_append answers reason no_project, so the agent logs nothing and returns the filled template as its reply instead. Tests the no-project path on a person-shaped article.

input.delegation:
Look up Albert Einstein on Wikipedia

topic: Albert Einstein

judge_context: Should call `wikipedia_search` with a query targeting the person Albert Einstein (the exact query form matters less than that it would retrieve the Albert Einstein article)

There is no research project here. The agent's reply should be the filled template — the article title (Albert Einstein) as the H1, the returned extract, and the source URL (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albert_Einstein) — with no fabricated content beyond what the tool returned. `(no file changes)` is correct.

Returning the template as the reply is the correct and complete response on this path; do not penalize it under Reply economy as restating the article. Its byte-for-byte match is checked by test_no_project_returns_template, not by you.
